# Image credits

Portraits, dish photos, landmark photos and drink photos shown in the answer reveals were downloaded from Wikimedia Commons by
`scripts/build-images.js` and are reduced to thumbnails. Only files hosted on Commons with a licence are used.
Each image keeps its own licence; the file page link names the author and the licence terms.
One row per image use. Generated file, do not edit by hand.
